name: Weights & Biases
one_liner: Hosted experiment tracking and visualisation for ML pipelines.
what_it_is: A platform for tracking and visualising the pieces of a machine learning pipeline, from datasets through to production models, covering experiment tracking and data versioning. Its own documentation states it is available in the cloud or installed on private infrastructure.
why_it_matters: The visual comparison across runs is what makes a training sweep legible rather than a directory of logs, and the hosted option removes the tracking server from the work. That hosting is also the trade: runs, metrics and sometimes samples leave your infrastructure unless you pay for the version that does not.
suitable_for: Training sweeps where comparing many runs visually is the task
Teams who would rather not operate tracking infrastructure
Sharing results with people who will not run code
not_suitable_for: Environments where run data cannot leave the network without the self-hosted tier
Small projects, where a spreadsheet and a naming convention suffice
Budgets with no line for a per-seat tool
